title: First Strand cDNA Synthesis
author: Maximilian Dietsch
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.k2scyee

steps.title: Prepare initial reaction mix
steps.instruction: In a sterile, nuclease‑free tube on ice, add the following in order: Template RNA (100 ng; range 1 pg–5 µg), Random Hexamer (1 µl, 100 pmol), dNTP Mix (1 µl, final concentration), and nuclease‑free water to bring the volume to 14.5 µl. Mix gently and centrifuge briefly.

steps.title: Optional GC‑rich RNA denaturation
steps.instruction: If the RNA is GC‑rich or highly structured, incubate the mixture at 65 °C for 5 min, then chill on ice, briefly centrifuge, and keep on ice.

steps.title: Add remaining reaction components
steps.instruction: Add the remaining reaction components as indicated (components not listed in the source), mix gently and centrifuge briefly.

steps.title: Reverse transcription incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the reaction as follows: 10 min at 25 °C, then 30 min at 50 °C (for GC‑rich RNA increase this step to 65 °C), and finally 5 min at 85 °C.

steps.title: Dilute and store cDNA
steps.instruction: Add 80 µl nuclease‑free water to the reaction. The cDNA can be used directly in qPCR or stored at –20 °C for up to one week.
